tickets.title: Evaluate Paper Otter Life term policy reinstatement
tickets.text: Evaluate reinstatement of Soren Cloudpuddle's $750,000, 20-year Paper Otter Life term policy before losing the existing underwriting terms. The lapse notice followed a failed premium draft after checking-account replacement.
tickets.evidence: 2024-12-13 agreed: evaluate lapse/reinstatement after notice showed draft failure when checking was replaced, before losing existing underwriting terms.

tickets.title: Review term-coverage and disability-protection for Cloudpuddle household
tickets.text: Review term life and disability protection against the household's $620,000 mortgage, childcare needs and education-funding exposure for Rowan, age 6. Account for Lila's reduction to part-time paid work and the resulting increased salary dependence.
tickets.evidence: 2024-12-20 agreed: review term-coverage/disability-protection after Lila reduced paid-work to part-time, increasing household dependence on his salary, with mortgage/childcare/education-funding exposure.
